Adhesive Quirk.name: Adhesive Quirk
Adhesive Quirk.description:
🕸️ Your body makes a strong adhesive, in strips of tape or sticky globs.

🌱 At the start you fire a strand or glob about ten meters to glue a hand, a foot or a weapon in place, and swing or haul yourself along lines that hold your weight.
📈 With training: harmless full-body wraps, people reeled from danger, catch-webs, plugged leaks and wounds, a glued street, a crowd bound in a pass, a building held up.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Finite Fuel, as the adhesive draws on what you eat and drink.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Hanta Sero (Tape), Minoru Mineta (Pop Off).

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Mobility +10, Capture +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Tack Shot, Tapeline Swing
Adhesive Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user makes tape or sticky globs from the skin, usually palms or forearms. A new adult user fires a strand or glob about ten meters, with lines that hold their weight or another adult's; it sets at once, stays tacky about an hour, then dries and flakes off. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: blades cut it, fire and solvents loosen it, dust and oil stop it holding, a strong person tears free with hard effort. It sticks to friend and foe, never the user; it cannot cut or crush; never on faces, where it can suffocate. Quirk Strain: light: shot, swing; moderate: wrap, reel-in, web; heavy: plugging a breach, gluing a street; severe: signature pass, holding a building together. Type: Emitter (also fits Mutant). Law: unlicensed gluing of a person is unlawful restraint; adhesive left on roads, platforms or exits endangers the public. Look: glossy adhesive in the player's color; as a Mutant Quirk, a permanent feature (tacky palms, forearm dispensers).
